node.title: The rational pair pencil has one coprime polynomial direction
node.closure: PID factorization of the rank-two pair-type determinant
node.statement: In the rank-at-most-two quotient pair-pencil branch, choose distinct base types p0,p1. There are fixed coprime polynomials U,V and at least 520 distinct scalar polynomials R_p in an F-linear space of dimension at most four such that (a_p,b_p)=(a_0,b_0)+R_p(U,V). Every nonzero difference R_p-R_q vanishes on H_p intersect H_q and therefore has at least 134940 official-domain roots. If d=max(deg U,deg V), then deg R_p<=K-1-d and d<=913635. This is an exact base-field-normalized rank-one support census input, not its payment.
